title: RC1-C03 — Customer local subdomain delivery
description: Managed publishing used internal managed hostname as primary customer-facing URL. Customer ecosystems must be served at local.<customer-domain> via CNAME to PharmaConnect infrastructure without modifying the customer root website.
expectedBehaviour: Canonical customer URL is https://local.<customer-domain>/; internal https://<tenant>.sites.pharmaconnect.uk/ is infrastructure/fallback only; CNAME instructions issued after domain confirmation; DNS and SSL verified before canonical URL activation
actualBehaviour: Managed URL was treated as primary public website; no customer subdomain URL model; no domain confirmation gate for parent/group website evidence
reproductionSteps: Open Banner Cross Managed Publishing — observe managed URL shown as primary destination without local.<domain> model
resolutionNotes: Customer ecosystem URL model implemented. Domain resolution from approved evidence with parent/group confirmation gate. Banner Cross evidence points to pharmacyhealthhub.co.uk — CUSTOMER DOMAIN CONFIRMATION REQUIRED before DNS.

resolutionHistory.notes: Generic customer publishing URL model, DNS/SSL verification flow, nginx tenant mapping, Master Admin UI updated

diagnosticSnapshot.note: Product Owner must confirm intended pharmacy-owned domain (e.g. bannercrosspharmacy.co.uk) before DNS
